encoding: client/soils.png R = index here, G = rock_fragments_pct, B = depth_to_bedrock_cm / 10 (255 = none/unknown)

rules.rock_fragments: sum of chfrags.fragvol_r in the surface horizon; 100 where the surface is unweathered bedrock (rock land) or the dominant component is Rock outcrop
rules.depth_to_bedrock: min corestrictions.resdept_r for reskind in ['lithic bedrock', 'paralithic bedrock']; else deepest horizon bottom (bedrock_restriction false); 0 for Rock outcrop
